SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. Section L.S. Station
No. S. B. D. 2588/2.
Date August 30, 1931.
at 12 / 30 p.m.

Subject (in full) Anti-Japanese Boycott and Local Japanese Industrialists and
Merchants.

Made by J.D.S. Umemoto. Forwarded by [Signature] A!

Acting upon the instructions of the Officer i/c
Special Branch, I interviewed Mr. Yoshida, manager of the
Mitsubishi Bank and concurrently Vice-Chairman of the Japanese
Chamber of Commerce, and several other prominent members of
the Chamber with the object of confirming the report published
in the Shanghai Nichi Nichi of August 6, 1931 regarding certain
resolutions passed at a meeting held at the Japanese Club at
2.30 p.m. August 5, 1931. They admitted that members of
the Friday Association, which was organized in 1926 by leading
Japanese industrialists and merchants to counteract the
activities of the Chinese anti-Japanese Association, called
the meeting to discuss measures to be adopted by local Japanese
to counteract the Chinese anti-Japanese boycott. They were,
however, reluctant to disclose the nature of their discussions
and the text of their petition which they have submitted to
Mr. Shigemitsu, the Japanese Minister, on the ground that it
was decided at the meeting not to communicate the text of the
petition with any other than the authorities concerned.

Further enquiries made in this connection show
that, after a lengthy discussion on the draft of petition to
be submitted to the Japanese Government, recommended by the
Special Committee of the Association, it was decided to accept
it, after altering certain points.

On August 8, 1931 Mr. Yonesato, the Chairman of
the Japanese Chamber of Commerce, visited the Japanese Consulate-
General and submitted to Mr. Shigemitsu, a petition, which is
reported to contain the following requests : -

1. That the Municipality of Greater Shanghai and
the Public Safety Bureau be requested to issue

日期 1931年8月30日。
时间 下午12时30分。

事由（全称） 抵制日货运动与在沪日本工商业者及商人。

呈报人 J.D.S. Umemoto。转呈人 [签名] A!

遵照特别科科长之指示，本人会见了三菱银行经理兼日本商会副会长吉田先生，以及商会的其他几位重要成员，目的是核实1931年8月6日《上海日日新闻》上刊登的关于1931年8月5日下午2时30分在日本俱乐部举行的会议上通过的某些决议的报道。他们承认，由主要日本工商业者为对抗名为“中华民国抗日救国会”的中国反日协会的活动而于1926年组织的“星期五协会”，召开了此次会议，以讨论在沪日本人应采取的对抗中国抵制日货运动的措施。然而，他们不愿透露讨论的性质以及已提交给日本公使重光葵先生的请愿书文本，理由是会议决定除有关当局外，不向任何其他方传达请愿书文本。

对此事的进一步调查显示，在对协会特别委员会推荐的拟提交日本政府的请愿书草案进行长时间讨论后，决定在对某些要点进行修改后予以接受。

1931年8月8日，日本商会会长米里先生访问了日本总领事馆，并向重光先生提交了一份请愿书，据称其中包含以下请求：

1. 请求大上海市政府和公安局发布

2. That self protective measures to be adopted by
the Association against the seizure of Japanese
goods be supported.

3. That compensation for the loss sustained by
detention of Japanese goods be demanded.

A very close observation over the lawless acts of
the anti-Japanese Association is being maintained and it is
confidentially learned that, as a means of self protective
measures, leading Japanese industrialists and merchants are
considering a proposal to employ about 50 armed guards
to protect Japanese goods while being transported on the River.

Information has also been received that in future
every seizure of Japanese goods by the anti-Japanese boycott
pickets will be reported to the Japanese Authorities who will
in turn negotiate direct with the Chinese Authorities for the
immediate release of the goods seized, demanding at the same
time compensation for loss sustained as a result of the seizure.

3. 要求赔偿因扣押日货所造成的损失。

目前正对抗日救国会的非法行为进行严密监视，并据密悉，作为自卫措施的一种手段，主要日本工商业者正在考虑雇用约50名武装警卫，以保护在河运途中的日货。

另获情报称，今后抗日抵制纠察队每扣押一次日货，都将向日本当局报告，日本当局将随即与中国当局直接交涉，要求立即释放被扣货物，同时要求赔偿因扣押造成的损失。

August 6, 1931.    Morning Translation.

ANTI-JAPANESE BOYCOTT AND LOCAL JAPANESE COMMERCIALISTS
**〔此处转录不清〕**

The Shanghai Nichi-Nichi publishes
the following report:-
At 2.30 p.m. yesterday local
Japanese industrialists and merchants held a meeting
at the Japanese Club to discuss the text of their
petition drafted by the Special Committee and to adopt
measures to counteract the Anti-Japanese boycott by
the Chinese. The feelings of those attending the
meeting became inflamed when they learned the news of
fresh seizures at Peetung. After a lengthy discussion
on the fundamental measures to be adopted to counter-
act the Chinese anti-Japanese boycott, recommended by
the Special Committee, it was decided to accept them,
after altering certain points. It was also decided
to submit the petition to-day or tomorrow to Mr.
Shigemitsu, Charge d'Affaires, and Mr. Kawai, Japanese
Consul-General, in the name of the Japanese Industrialist
Association and to Japan in the name of the Japanese
Chamber of Commerce.
The petition contains the following requests:-
1. That the **〔此处转录不清〕** Municipality and the Public
**〔此处转录不清〕** be requested to oppose **〔此处转录不清〕** of the Anti-Japanese
Association.
2. That dissolution of **〔此处转录不清〕** be demanded.
3. Self protective measures against **〔此处转录不清〕**.
4. **〔此处转录不清〕** against detention of Japanese
goods.
It was also decided to maintain very close
observation over the influences of the Anti-Japanese
Association.

1931年8月6日。 晨间译文。
（续。）

抵制日货运动与在沪日本商界人士
**〔此处转录不清〕**

《上海日日新闻》刊登如下报道：
昨日下午2时30分，在沪日本工商业者在日本俱乐部举行会议，讨论由特别委员会起草的请愿书文本，并通过对抗中国人抵制日货运动的措施。当与会者获悉北新泾发生新的扣押事件的消息时，情绪变得激动。在对特别委员会推荐的对抗中国抵制日货运动的基本措施进行长时间讨论后，决定在对某些要点进行修改后予以接受。还决定以日本工业家协会的名义，于今日或明日向代办重光先生和日本总领事河相先生提交请愿书，并以日本商会的名义向日本国内提交。
请愿书包含以下请求：
1. 请求 **〔此处转录不清〕** 市政府和公共 **〔此处转录不清〕** 反对抗日救国会的 **〔此处转录不清〕**。
2. 要求解散 **〔此处转录不清〕**。
3. 针对 **〔此处转录不清〕** 的自卫措施。
4. 针对扣押日货的 **〔此处转录不清〕**。
还决定对抗日救国会的影响保持非常密切的观察。
